Point A is located on the polar circle line above and is on the daylight side; point B is located about 45° west of the intersection point of this terminator. Reasoning: Point A is on the polar circle and on the daylight side, indicating that polar day appears near the Arctic Circle, so it should be the summer solstice in the Northern Hemisphere, namely June 22. The intersection of the terminator and the equator is located on the morning line, and the local time of the morning line on the equator is 6:00. Point B is about 45° west of this point; for every 15° difference in longitude, local time differs by 1 hour, so 45° corresponds to 3 hours; local time is earlier westward, so the time at point B is 6:00 minus 3 hours, namely 3:00. The date is still June 22, so the time at point B may be 3:00 on June 22.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的昼夜分布：白色区域在右上，黑夜阴影在左下，A在上方极圈且处于白昼侧，说明北极圈附近出现极昼，判定日期为6月22日。再看斜晨昏线与赤道/中央经线的交点，该点在赤道上，按晨线判断地方时为6时。读出B点位于该交点以西约45°经度，地方时比该点晚/早按经度换算为早3小时，因此B点可能为6月22日3时。
